late_delivery.title: Late delivery
late_delivery.text: For an overdue shipment, support may review the carrier scan and offer a tracking investigation; no compensation is automatic.
restrictions: A delay does not automatically authorize a refund
Never invent a new arrival date

damaged_product.title: Damaged product
damaged_product.text: Customers may provide photos of the damaged item and packaging. Support evaluates a replacement or refund request after verifying the claim.
conditions: Photos and damage details may be requested
restrictions: Damage must be reviewed by human support

missing_order.title: Missing order
missing_order.text: Support investigates missing shipments and requests carrier tracking evidence. A replacement or refund requires separate authorization.

incorrect_item.title: Incorrect item
incorrect_item.text: Support requests photographs of the received item and packing slip to confirm an incorrect shipment before considering a correction.

refund_request.title: Refund eligibility
refund_request.text: In this fictional demo policy, a standard request for delivered items should be made within 14 calendar days of recorded delivery. Requests still require human verification and approval.
conditions: Request submitted within 14 calendar days of delivery for normal eligibility

order_cancellation.title: Order cancellation
order_cancellation.text: A cancellation request must be reviewed against shipment and payment status before being processed by authorized staff.
restrictions: Never cancel directly from this demo app

delivery_delay.title: Delivery delays
delivery_delay.text: Tracking updates are reviewed for transit exceptions. Support may request a carrier status update; an exact arrival date cannot be guaranteed.

unresponsive_support.title: Unresponsive customer support
unresponsive_support.text: Customers reporting repeated unanswered contacts should be escalated to a human agent for a response review.
conditions: Review available contact history when authorized
restrictions: Do not claim previous contacts were checked without records
escalate_when: Two or more alleged unanswered contacts

other.title: General complaints
other.text: Issues without a specific verified category are referred to human support for case assessment.
conditions: Verify order and identity if relevant
restrictions: No assumptions about account history or resolution
